interpretation: Bare F1 and F1() return the definition without evaluating Home X. A numeric literal has type0, a word has type1, and an expression including2+3 or√(4) retains type8 until called.
String and quoted expression assignments preserve the expression rather than resolving live variables. Numeric calls use current caller memory and leave Home X unchanged.
Invalid syntax, direct complex values, quoted text bodies and vector literal text are rejected atomically. Complex-pair and list literal TEXT bodies are accepted as symbolic definitions.

Clearing a definition returns an empty text value; subsequent reads and calls fail. A separately captured UI-entered checked function became unchecked after clear and remained unchecked after PPL reassignment.
PPL assignment preserves an existing nonempty definition checkbox and leaves fresh rows unchecked. UI entry selects the row for plotting and Numeric.
A checked word constant #FFh appears as255 in Numeric. A checked list body{1,2} displays NaN cells while calls in PPL return the actual list.

Native currently keeps complex-pair definition text in unambiguous PPL tuple syntax. Original STRING normalizes(1,2) to1+2*i; matching that presentation while retaining literal identity remains unfinished.
